name: swanUSD
oneLiner: swanUSD is a SwanDAO-governed dollar stablecoin minted against wstETH on Inverse Finance's Monolith CDP factory, live on Ethereum since October 2026.
collateral: wstETH deposited in swanUSD's Monolith Lender (0x4ed5c72816abc1b67ac31ddabe31cff4a8c56a15), which held 44.10 wstETH at Ethereum block 26268775 on October 25 2026 against 213,731.85 swanUSD supply. The issuer site also describes 1:1 swaps with sUSDS; that module and the gap between supply and Lender debt are not yet reconciled.
pegMechanism: Monolith CDP instance: borrowers mint swanUSD against wstETH at 0% or a variable rate under Monolith's dual free and paid debt system, the issuer site says swanUSD is redeemable for wstETH, and stakers deposit it in the sSwanUSD ERC-4626 vault to earn borrower interest.
launchPhaseDetail: Monolith announced on October 22 2026 that swanUSD is live on Ethereum as a DAO-governed stablecoin backed by wstETH, built on Inverse Finance's Monolith factory (V2 deployment index 2). The token 0x9bf2b2f57a2968a0e81546ed50cbbbb7c9d6e05e (18 decimals, Ethereum only) is a non-proxy Coin contract whose only minter is its Lender; supply was 213,731.85 at block 26268775 on October 25 2026. Pharos tracks it pre-launch because no price source admits it: there is no CoinGecko or DefiLlama stablecoin listing, and DefiLlama's contract quote was about two hours old on October 25, outside the 15-minute freshness budget.

milestones.title: swanUSD launches on Monolith
milestones.description: Monolith announced that swanUSD is live on Ethereum as a DAO-governed stablecoin backed by wstETH and built on Inverse Finance's Monolith factory. Holders can stake it as sSwanUSD to earn protocol revenue. A 100,000 SWAN launch airdrop opened the same day.
